definitions: A yellow-brown pigment composed of oxidized lipids and proteins, which accumulates in lysosomes of cells, especially in postmitotic cells such as neurons and cardiac myocytes, as a byproduct of cellular aging.
examples: The accumulation of lipofuscin is a hallmark of cellular aging.
Researchers are studying the role of lipofuscin in neurodegenerative diseases.
Lipofuscin granules were observed in the cytoplasm of the aged cells.
